title: Dentaltown
html:
Welcome to the dark side. DentalTown now has dark mode, giving the entire site a fresh new look that's easier on the eyes when things get a little dim. If your device is set to dark mode, we'll automatically match it. Prefer to make the call yourself? Choose Light, Dark, or System anytime from your profile menu.

Aug 25  

Hold onto your loupes. We've spent the past several months under the hood tuning and cleaning up our servers, and the results speak for themselves: pages that once took seconds to respond are now measured in milliseconds. And, that speed boost doesn't stop at our servers. We moved our images and media onto a global content delivery network, so everything loads fast no matter where in the world you're Townie-ing from. You won't see this update, but you're already feeling it!

Jul 31  

And... ACTION! Posting a video used to be a multi-step chore - not anymore! We've streamlined and modernized the whole process: upload your video in a single step, right from the editor, and watch a real progress bar follow it from upload all the way through processing. In a hurry? Go ahead and submit your post - your video will finish processing on its own and appear when it's ready. That's a wrap on the hassle.

Jul 3  

Extra! Extra! Introducing the Farran Report - our new dental news section featuring commentary straight from Dr. Howard Farran himself. Industry news without the fluff, served with Howard's signature no-holds-barred take. One more reason to make Dentaltown your first stop of the day.

Jun 19  

Our Townie Choice Awards got a makeover worthy of the winners. We rebuilt the entire ballot experience from the ground up: a clean streamlined flow, plus the freedom to step away and pick up right where you left off. Voting has never been easier! And when the winners are crowned, the results got a glow-up too: every winner for the year on one easy to view page, organized into expandable categories with product photos, with full voting breakdowns just one click away. From ballot to bragging rights, the whole TCA experience is brand new. Check it out!
